description: F2P/P2P classification of this task's graded observations. F2P fail on the delivered state and pass after the reference repair; P2P pass on both. Measured in the task image, not derived from names. tests/grade_rs.py reads this file and runs exactly the observations it names.

groups.requirement: SeqAccessDeserializer, MapAccessDeserializer, EnumAccessDeserializer wrap the corresponding access traits; forward_to_deserialize_any forwards hinted methods. (serde_core/src/de/value.rs: access deserializers)
BorrowedBytesDeserializer always dispatches to visit_borrowed_bytes. (serde_core/src/de/value.rs: borrowed-bytes-adapter)
BorrowedStrDeserializer enables borrowed string deserialization. (serde_core/src/de/value.rs: borrowed-string-adapter)
Visitor::visit_char forwards the input character as a one-character string. (serde_core/src/de/mod.rs: char-utf8)
Serializer::collect_map serializes every pair yielded by the iterator. (serde_core/src/ser/mod.rs: collect-map-pairs)
Serializer::collect_seq serializes every item yielded by the iterator. (serde_core/src/ser/mod.rs: collect-sequence-items)
Serde provides generic Serialize and Deserialize implementations for Rust data structures. (serde_core/README.md: framework)

Visitor defaults reject unexpected types using invalid_type; invalid_value describes unsuitable values; Expected delegates to Visitor::expecting and custom constructs deserialization errors. (serde_core/src/de/mod.rs: Error, Unexpected, Expected)
Impossible provides compound associated types for a Serializer that supports scalar values but rejects sequences. (serde_core/src/ser/impossible.rs: Impossible example)

IgnoredAny permits selecting the nth sequence value while consuming the ignored prefix and suffix; a missing selected value reports invalid_length. (serde_core/src/de/ignored_any.rs: NthElement example)

Missing optional fields deserialize as None while required missing fields error; internally tagged enums find their tag and untagged enums may retry captured content. (serde/src/private/de.rs: missing_field and tagged content)

Primitive Serialize implementations pass their value to the corresponding Serializer method; Serializer defaults reject i128 and u128 and default to human-readable mode. (serde_core/src/ser/mod.rs: primitive serialization and defaults)
Serde provides generic Serialize and Deserialize implementations for Rust data structures. (crates-io.md: framework)
Deserialize::deserialize_in_place replaces a value; Deserializer defaults to human-readable; value deserializers forward hints. (serde_core/src/de/mod.rs: Deserialize and Deserializer)
EnumAccess exposes a variant identifier; VariantAccess reads newtype, tuple and struct variant payloads. (serde_core/src/de/mod.rs: EnumAccess and VariantAccess)
IgnoredAny discards values of arbitrary types, consuming complete sequences and maps. (serde_core/src/de/ignored_any.rs: IgnoredAny)
SerializeMap::serialize_entry delegates the key and value to their respective methods. (serde_core/src/ser/mod.rs: map-entry-payload)
MapDeserializer::end does not reject a pending value after its key was read. (serde_core/src/de/value.rs: map-pending-value)
MapAccess::next_key and next_value return the actual key and value. (serde_core/src/de/mod.rs: MapAccess next_key next_value)
Visitor::visit_byte_buf forwards the complete byte buffer to visit_bytes. (serde_core/src/de/mod.rs: owned-bytes-content)
Visitor::visit_string forwards the complete string to visit_str. (serde_core/src/de/mod.rs: owned-string-content)
Ctxt::new has no errors; check consumes collected errors; dropping an unchecked context panics outside unwinding. (serde_derive/src/internals/ctxt.rs: Ctxt)
StringDeserializer and CowStrDeserializer deserialize the string value they hold without altering its contents. (serde_core/src/de/value.rs: StringDeserializer and CowStrDeserializer)
Serde provides generic Serialize and Deserialize implementations for Rust data structures. (README.md: framework)
Seed access returns data and exhaustion; EnumAccess::variant and unit_variant deserialize a unit variant. (serde_core/src/de/mod.rs: access seeds and enum variants)
IntoDeserializer wraps a value; SeqDeserializer::deserialize_seq passes sequence access to Visitor::visit_seq. (serde_core/src/de/value.rs: IntoDeserializer and SeqDeserializer)
SeqDeserializer iterates over a sequence and Deserialize reads all elements. (serde_core/src/de/value.rs: SeqDeserializer)
SeqDeserializer::end rejects any remaining sequence elements. (serde_core/src/de/value.rs: sequence-tail-validation)
Serializer::collect_str uses Display; serialize_some, serialize_bytes, serialize_newtype_struct preserve payload. (serde_core/src/ser/mod.rs: Serializer)
SerializeStruct and SerializeStructVariant::skip_field do nothing; Serializer::is_human_readable defaults true. (serde_core/src/ser/mod.rs: skip_field and is_human_readable)
Value deserializers expose boolean, string, bytes and unit option input through hinted deserialization. (serde_core/src/de/value.rs: primitive value deserializers)
visit_borrowed_bytes forwards to visit_bytes; unsigned narrow inputs forward to visit_u64. (serde_core/src/de/mod.rs: Visitor unsigned and borrowed fallbacks)
Visitor defaults reject boolean, unsigned, floating point, and unit input. (serde_core/src/de/mod.rs: Visitor rejection defaults)
Visitor::visit_i8, visit_i16, visit_i32 forward to visit_i64; visit_borrowed_str forwards to visit_str. (serde_core/src/de/mod.rs: Visitor numeric and borrowed fallbacks)
Visitor::visit_i128 rejects by default even when visit_i64 is implemented. (serde_core/src/de/mod.rs: wide-signed-rejection)
